dataFamilies.rationale: Authentication identity is removed after dependent application data and required provider cleanup complete.
Encrypted Gmail credentials are deleted after provider revocation is confirmed; retry-required cleanup may retain only the encrypted credential until cleanup can be completed.
Imported Gmail-derived records are user-scoped application data and are removed by the existing destructive lifecycle operations.
Derived financial context based on deleted imported data must not survive or be recreated by deletion-triggered processing.
Notification delivery registrations are operational endpoints and are removed when the associated session/account is revoked.

User-scoped provider leads, dispatch queue entries, commerce matches and commerce events are removed by the existing account-deletion lifecycle. Any future legal retention exception would require a separately designed non-user-content audit record and owner/legal approval.
Operational evidence should use pseudonymous actor references and exclude direct identifiers/secrets; exact retention window requires owner security/privacy policy.

Release identities, immutable source SHAs, artifact digests, approvals and recovery evidence are required for operational traceability and must not contain user content or secret values; exact retention duration requires owner policy.
